metadata.description: Opinionated skill collection for professional software engineering workflows — modular, replaceable packages for every phase of daily work and SDLC.

plugins.name: strict-workday
plugins.description: Skills for daily work execution — operating rhythm, focus, time management, day planning.

plugins.name: strict-communication
plugins.description: Skills for communication support — drafting messages, Slack/email, summaries.

plugins.name: strict-development
plugins.description: Skills for engineering implementation — technical design, architecture, coding, PR prep.

plugins.name: strict-management
plugins.description: Skills for management and lead-level planning — decomposition, sprint, prioritization, backlog.

plugins.name: strict-quality
plugins.description: Skills for product quality and verification — testing, quality gates, validation evidence.

plugins.name: strict-security
plugins.description: Skills for security practices — security review, secure design, secrets, vulnerability checks.

plugins.name: strict-workflows
plugins.description: Composed end-to-end workflows — reusable multi-step flows across the full SDLC.

plugins.name: strict-knowledge
plugins.description: Skills for knowledge and procedure handling — playbooks, internal procedures, grounded guidance.

plugins.name: strict-foundation
plugins.description: Shared reusable primitives — abstract skills, rules, policies, templates, hooks.

plugins.name: strict-adapters
plugins.description: Tool-specific knowledge modules — one focused adapter per tool, API, CLI, or SDK.

plugins.name: strict-labs
plugins.description: Experimental and unstable content — early skills and drafts being evaluated.

plugins.name: strict-deprecated
plugins.description: Skills pending removal — each has a confirmed replacement. Not invocable directly.
